facts.fact: The World Bank says the Merankabandi social registry is also used by the World Bank-financed Soleil-Nyakiriza solar energy project to reach vulnerable households for subsidised solar kits.

The World Bank blog says the Merankabandi (Cash for Jobs) programme's CORE-MIS connects with multiple payment service providers, easing payment processing and reconciliation, and that field data collected with KoboToolbox flows directly into it; it was used to deliver emergency cash transfers to over 30,000 beneficiaries.

facts.fact: The World Bank team said in January 2026 that the CORE-MIS system of the Merankabandi project is interconnected with several payment service providers, and that field data from KoboToolbox flows into it automatically.
